fields.name: client_logo
fields.label: Client Logo
fields.instructions: Upload the approved client logo. Keep its original artwork and colors.

fields.name: logo_status
fields.label: Logo Approval Status
fields.instructions: Only Approved logos can appear publicly. This does not approve project images.

fields.name: show_in_marquee
fields.label: Show in Selected Clients
fields.instructions: Enable this client in the Home Selected Clients marquee. No public project is required.

fields.name: website_url
fields.label: Website URL
fields.instructions: Optional. Does not automatically make a logo link.

fields.name: visible
fields.label: Legacy Visibility
fields.instructions: Previous setting retained for compatibility. Does not control Selected Clients.

fields.name: sort_order
fields.label: Legacy Sort Order
fields.instructions: Previous setting retained for compatibility. Does not control marquee order.
